answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to lock capital to participate in governance. An attacker facing this economic gale must deploy significant financial resources, much like scattering precious saffron into an infinite ocean, to acquire enough tokens for network dominance. Because the cost of entry scales linearly with capital accumulation, malicious agents are disincentivized from creating multiple fake identities, as each additional node dilutes their own stake efficacy.
